summary: Schneider National filed an 8-K reporting a routine board expansion and quarterly dividend. The board increased from ten to eleven directors and appointed CEO James S. Filter as a director, effective July 27, 2026, with no additional compensation. The company declared a $0.10 per share quarterly cash dividend for Q3 2026, payable October 9, 2026, to shareholders of record September 11, 2026. No special-situation elements—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review—are present. The filing consists solely of standard governance and capital return events.
